projects.factory.frontend_recommendation: Recommended for richer product UIs with complex state, decoupled theming, reporting, multi-tenant needs or white-label branding.
Good fit for simpler or server-first websites with lower interactive complexity and less frontend overhead.
projects.factory.db_recommendation.title: Recommended engine
projects.factory.db_recommendation.reaso: Good fit for static, CLI or lightweight apps that do not need durable business data.
Good fit for local-first, desktop, mobile or single-user apps with embedded persistence and no heavy concurrency.
Recommended for web/API, multi-user, RBAC, enterprise SSO, reporting, background jobs or serious deployment targets.
projects.factory.db_recommendation.files: The filesystem is auxiliary storage, not the primary database for business data.
projects.factory.db_recommendation.manua: You can override this recommendation manually if your case needs something else.
projects.factory.auth_recommendation.rea: Good fit when the app does not need login or access control.
Recommended for web apps with first-party frontend and backend under the same control.
Recommended for decoupled APIs consumed by external clients or separate frontends.
Recommended for mobile or delegated clients that need standard provider-backed flows.
Recommended when there is a corporate identity provider such as Active Directory, LDAP or Entra ID.
Recommended for simple CLI or machine-to-machine integrations.
projects.factory.deployment_recommendati: Good default for backend services and web/API apps deployed as a service.
Recommended when container orchestration is already part of the target operating model.
Good fit for lightweight frontends or services without a strong resident core.
Good fit for local executables, desktop apps or CLI tools shipped outside containers.
Recommended for firmware, embedded runtimes or device-adjacent deployment.
projects.factory.artifact_recommendation: Good default for services or utilities that run as a binary or resident process.
Recommended when the main deployment target is containers.
Use only when the primary product is an SDK or reusable component.
Recommended for desktop apps distributed to end users.
Recommended for Android or iOS apps packaged for mobile distribution.
Recommended for embedded devices or software tightly coupled to hardware.
Recommended for purely static sites without a first-party backend.
projects.factory.recommendation.manual: You can override this recommendation manually if your case needs something else.
